selection: Copy all law/type/def spans for each selected name from maintained source.py blocks, preserving their source order; do not copy whole modules or an existing main.

modes.reference: Read input before clock; materialize reference tokens; consume every token/text field into count and checksum.
modes.candidate: Read input before clock; materialize candidate tokens; consume every token/text field into count and checksum.
modes.compare: Read input before clock; compare complete token lists exactly, then consume both into observations. Combined timing is diagnostic, not an alternating performance comparison.
modes.controls: PATH is an ignored required sentinel. Run exact comparator mutation controls and every finite text under five cursor/lookbehind/depth configurations.

limits: Dependency inventory is a read-only source audit, not a successful Bend source check. Root must independently check the assembled source and authenticate native assets. Checksums are observations, not the exact comparison oracle. External guard clock charges startup, IO, reporting and remaining destruction.
